questions.question: A boat travels 54 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 3 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 54/3 = 18 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 18 − 3 = 15 km/h.
